heading: EXT. PAWS AND PEACE PET CREMATORIUM DRIVE-THRU - DAY

units.text: EXT. PAWS AND PEACE PET CREMATORIUM DRIVE-THRU - DAY
A cheerful pastel kiosk with a speaker box and a pull-up window.
WALLY PRUITT, fifties, in a polo shirt with a paw-print logo, sits inside with a headset on.
KIKI NAKAMURA, twenties, his new trainee, stands behind him holding a clipboard.
He taps the headset.
She leans in to watch.
Okay, Kiki, first rule. We never say "dead."
units.name: WALLY

units.text: What do we say?
units.name: KIKI

units.text: "Passed on to the big yard."
units.name: WALLY

units.text: She writes it down.
He presses a button.
Welcome to Paws and Peace. How can we comfort you today?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: The speaker crackles.
Yeah, hi. I got a pet. It's, uh, in the car. Back seat.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: I'm so sorry for your loss, sir. May I ask what kind of companion?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: A python. Eleven feet.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: He freezes.
She stops writing.
They look at each other.
Wally, is that a big yard thing?
units.name: KIKI

units.text: Hush. (into mic) Sir, ah, our standard urn holds up to eighty pounds.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: He's got a roommate. She's pretty upset.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: The, uh, the family is grieving?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: No. The other python. She's in the car too.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: Kiki drops the clipboard.
He waves a hand at her to stay calm, then peers through the window at a dusty hatchback idling in the lane.
The hatchback's rear window is a solid wall of coiled scales.
Wally, the glass is moving.
units.name: KIKI

units.text: Don't say "moving."
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Hey, Wally, right? Your tag says Wally. Can you make the window go up? I think she's trying to hug the heater.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: He rips off the headset and stands.
She backs toward the door.
Kiki. Kiki! Be a pro. Tell him we will be right out.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: You tell him!
units.name: KIKI

units.text: I am training YOU!
units.name: WALLY

units.text: The speaker crackles again.
Is this a bad time? I can come back.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: Wally and Kiki both shout "No!" at the same moment, then stare at each other, appalled.
